nodes.name: 1. Load settings from the Google Sheet

parameters.content:
## 1. Trigger + load settings
Runs daily at 06:00 UTC (or manually). Reads **Settings**, **Prompts** and already-processed URLs from the Google Sheet. Edit the sheet, not this workflow, to change filters, models or prompts.

## 2. Fetch + filter jobs
Public APIs: Himalayas (search), RemoteOK, Jobicy. Normalised to one schema, then keyword / company / age filter and duplicate check.

## 3. AI (OpenRouter)
LLM 1 verifies **remote + English + relevant** (and not an agency). Matches get a personalised message from LLM 2 and go to **Leads**; the rest go to **Rejected** with the reason.

## 4. Log + save
Adds a row to **Run Log** and saves the full run as JSON on the server (/files).
